ladaf/poisfft.manifest:
name = "poisfft"
version = "0.0.0"
license = "GPL-2.0-or-later"
[library]
source-dir = "playground-library"
include-dir = ["src", "."]
[build]
external-modules = ["pfft", "mpi"]
auto-executables = false
auto-examples = false
auto-tests = false
[install]
library = true
[fortran]
implicit-typing = true
implicit-external = true
source-form = "default"
[preprocess.cpp]
suffixes = ["f90"]

edits.after:
module FFT_SP
#if 0
  ! Dependency declarations for the FPM scanner; actual USEs are in fft-inc.f90.
  use PoisFFT_Precisions
  use PoisFFT_Parameters
  use fftw3
#endif
#define PREC 1

scope: Serial FFTW Poisson solvers. An FPM wrapper selects the Fortran library modules, retains upstream template includes, adds CPP-disabled USE declarations for the FPM dependency scanner, declares unused MPI/PFFT modules external for scanning, enables CPP and links Debian FFTW 3.3.10 single/double and thread libraries. MPI/PFFT and C/C++ bindings are not offered. The checked double-precision periodic 1D spectral problem compares its solution with sin(2*pi*x) at 32 points. Other boundary conditions, finite-difference modes, nonuniform grids, higher-dimensional solvers, single precision and parallel execution are not validated.
